data: For fiscal 2024, the year ended January 28, 2024, NVIDIA reported revenue of $60,922 million (about $60.9 billion) and net income of $29,760 million (about $29.8 billion), or $11.93 per diluted share, according to its Form 10-K filed February 21, 2024. Revenue rose from $26,974 million in fiscal 2023, the year ended January 29, 2023. That is an increase of $33,948 million, or about 125.9% year over year, so revenue more than doubled. Net income grew faster, from $4,368 million in fiscal 2023 to $29,760 million, an increase of roughly 581%. Part of that jump reflects a one-time $1,353 million acquisition termination cost that reduced fiscal 2023 profit.
